title: Font Presets — the five scripts of pdfnative 1.8.0

metadata.author: pdfnative-cli samples
metadata.subject: --font lo nod khb tdd cjm: Lao, Tai Tham, New Tai Lue, Tai Le, Cham (27 scripts in all) — demonstration content
metadata.keywords: fonts, lao, tai tham, new tai lue, tai le, cham

blocks.text: --font <code> registers the bundled Noto module for that script and --lang <code> embeds it. pdfnative 1.8.0 adds lo, nod, khb, tdd and cjm to the 22 codes of 1.7.0; ha, yo, ig and sw are aliases of latin. Run pdfnative doctor to list the inventory and check every module is on disk.
